consequence.statement: Path handling by ingress controllers changes: paths now require an exact match (pathType: Exact) instead of the previous controller-specific matching (pathType: ImplementationSpecific); the evidence frames this as more reliable and more secure and reports no failure.
consequence.remediation: Verify that the ingress controllers handling the affected Ingress resources behave correctly with pathType: Exact.

assertion.statement: In cert-manager 1.18.0, the Kubernetes Ingress pathType is changed from ImplementationSpecific to Exact for more reliable handling of ingress controllers and enhanced security.
